task: Build the smallest honest MEASUREMENT of hallucinations in Python — a tiny labelled set and a score. Ten examples is enough if they are honest. Talk through what the number would have to say to change your mind.
hidden_tests: run it and ask what the number MEANS — a score with no interpretation is not a measurement
ask how many examples his score would need before he would trust it, and why that number
plant one mislabelled example and see whether he notices the score move
